name: Call of Fire

angles.text: To commune with fire spirits and seek the Eternal Flame, you forge an elemental bond with a fire sapta. This path leads toward the fire totem.
As a dwarf, you find Braldir Ashmantle guiding initiates in Loch Modan. He sees fire as the breath of the forge and creation, not mere destruction.
In Alliance lands, you face local trogg and kobold threats as you take part in shamanic rites in Loch Modan.

faq.answer: Aspiring shaman undertake Call of Fire to seek communion with the Eternal Flame. First, they prepare a fire sapta to bind their mortal spirit to the element.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Braldir Ashmantle guides initiates in Loch Modan. He teaches the balance of fire and prepares a fire sapta once they gather the needed reagents.
A fire sapta is a preparation made from reagents bound to flame. It attunes and binds a shaman’s spirit to fire, making communion with the Eternal Flame possible.

aliases: where do i get fire tar
faq.answer: Tunnel Rat Geomancers carry fire tar in their caves in northern Loch Modan. They use it in their primitive fire crafts.
faq.q: Where is the fire tar found?

aliases: where do i get reagent pouch
faq.answer: Stonesplinter Seers carry reagent pouches in the southern hills of Loch Modan. The trogg mystics use them to hold reagents tied to elemental magic.
faq.q: Where is the Stonesplinter reagent pouch found?

faq.answer: Braldir teaches that fire is more than destruction: it is forge, life, and the breath of creation. In balance with other forces, it tempers cold stone and gives warmth and purpose to existence.
faq.q: How does Braldir Ashmantle view the element of fire?

sections.body: In Loch Modan, Braldir Ashmantle guides initiates who seek the power of flame. Before they can commune with fire spirits, they must attune their mortal spirits with a sacred draught called a fire sapta. Without it, the Eternal Flame would consume them instead of enlightening them. Braldir asks each petitioner to gather two reagents from hostile valley dwellers and prove their resolve.
sections.title: The Path to the Flame

sections.body: A fire sapta needs substances rich in elemental power. In the north, Tunnel Rat Geomancers gather sticky fire tar in their warrens to fuel their subterranean magic. In the south, Stonesplinter Seers carry reagent pouches filled with primitive elemental charms across the hills. Claiming these items means facing two of Loch Modan’s most entrenched pests, and gaining what is needed to bind an initiate’s soul to flame.
sections.title: Reagents of the Earth and Spark

sections.body: Once the reagents are gathered, Braldir Ashmantle teaches patience alongside the power to destroy. To him, fire means more than fury and ash. It is life, the craft of the forge, and the breath of creation. Mastery calls for balance: shadow gives meaning to light, and flame keeps stone from being only a cold memory. To master fire, an initiate must learn when to blend rather than burn.
sections.title: The Tempering of Wisdom

summary: In Loch Modan, initiates seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem it grants. Braldir Ashmantle guides them through a trial that calls for reagents from kobolds and troggs. They prepare a fire sapta and learn that flame can forge and give life as well as destroy.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
